integrity: Student sketch distribution and deterministic Chebyshev bounds are established sources; the proposed exact budget law is a derived combination. No independent publication-priority verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic, real SPD spectrum, independently drawn Gaussian sketch for each chosen one-shot degree, uniform worst case, fixed K before s tends to infinity; does not optimize computational time or adaptive stopping.
title: A sharp fixed-sketch budget law for Gaussian-sketched Krylov residuals
